props.copy:
Job lifecycle (6 states, 8 transitions)
States:
- Idle (initial state)
- Running (state)
- Waiting for a worker (state)
- Done (final state)
- Failed (error state)
- Orphaned (state)
Transitions:
1. Idle to Waiting for a worker on enqueue
2. Waiting for a worker to Running on start
3. Running to Done on finish
4. Running to Failed on crash
5. Failed to Running on retry [attempts < 3]
6. Running to Running on heartbeat
7. Running to Running on checkpoint
8. Orphaned to Idle on adopt

html:
Job lifecycle

A job waits, runs, and ends done or failed; failed jobs retry up to three times. (6 states, 8 transitions)

  • Idle (initial state): Waiting in the queue.
  • Running (state)
  • Waiting for a worker (state)
  • Done (final state)
  • Failed (error state)
  • Orphaned (state, unreachable from the initial state)
  1. Idle to Waiting for a worker on enqueue
  2. Waiting for a worker to Running on start
  3. Running to Done on finish
  4. Running to Failed on crash
  5. Failed to Running on retry [attempts < 3]
  6. Running to Running on heartbeat
  7. Running to Running on checkpoint
  8. Orphaned to Idle on adopt
